I need to determine what type of animal is the star of the 2005 film "Racing Stripes."

The film "Racing Stripes" is about a zebra who wants to be a racehorse. The main character, Stripes, is indeed a zebra who was abandoned at a farm and dreams of racing. This is a well-documented fact about this family film.

Both other agents answered "Zebra" with high confidence (0.96), and this aligns with my knowledge of the film. The title itself is a play on words - "stripes" referring to the zebra's distinctive markings.

Answer: Zebra
Confidence: 0.98
